title: Kitten wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f7b267'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#f4a259'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#ffc078'/>
  <!-- head lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#ffd8a8'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='32,34 28,16 44,28' fill='#ffc078'/>
  <polygon points='68,34 72,16 56,28' fill='#ffc078'/>
  <polygon points='34,32 31,22 42,29' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <polygon points='66,32 69,22 58,29' fill='#ffb3c1'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='46.5' r='1.8' fill='#cdffcd'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='46.5' r='1.8' fill='#cdffcd'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,54 47.5,57 52.5,57' fill='#ff7a9e'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 57 Q46 61 43 59' stroke='#ff7a9e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 57 Q54 61 57 59' stroke='#ff7a9e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='52' x2='14' y2='49' stroke='#ffd8a8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='57' x2='14' y2='58' stroke='#ffd8a8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='52' x2='86' y2='49' stroke='#ffd8a8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='57' x2='86' y2='58' stroke='#ffd8a8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 34,32 66,32' fill='#5b8def'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,22 56,22' fill='#7fb0ff'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <line x1='39.5' y1='26' x2='60.5' y2='26' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.6'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='18' x2='56' y2='18' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.4'/>
  <!-- pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ff7a9e'/>

  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd8a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd8a8'/>
</svg>
